_help: Settings of this document. body.js and assemble.ps1 read them. Keys that start with _ are notes.
title: Title of the document
author: Full name of the student
_template: The lecturer's template that holds the cover. Use "" if the document has no cover from a template.
_coverEnd: The text of the first paragraph of the template after the cover. Everything before it is the cover.
_coverAfter: Inside the cover: put the value right after the label text.
_coverReplace: Inside the cover: replace the text with the value (at most 255 characters).
_coverTables: Inside the cover: the first table that holds the text 'find' gets the values in row 'row', from the first column. null keeps a cell.
